suggestions.rationale: Mapping Expansion Batch ME-13 adds this draft-primary relationship only as a bounded clinical proposition. Vincristine used for hematologic malignancies, including non-Hodgkin lymphoma, can cause progressive peripheral sensory and motor neuropathy; the approved mapping is restricted to a documented neurotoxic treatment exposure with compatible chronology. Require documented non-Hodgkin lymphoma, a documented vincristine-containing or otherwise specifically neurotoxic lymphoma regimen, compatible chronology, and separately established peripheral neuropathy. Do not infer peripheral neuropathy from non-Hodgkin lymphoma itself. Preserve diabetic, nutritional, alcohol-related, compressive, paraproteinemic, infectious, hereditary, and other neuropathy etiologies as competing explanations. The cited literature supports only this constrained proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
